claims.title: Hide audit-versus-payload roles in quantum inputs and swap interfaces under complete memory accounting

quoted_fields.interface: One identified logical qubit and a complete CPTP call including all future-accessible bath/registers; the same physical port/call, fresh keys independent of the initial input/reference and apparatus state, private role choices and actual trusted input/output operations. Complete-instrument substitution uses destructive tests and retirement of carriers, keys and fine records from future-used state/control, with only coarse-history reuse. The weaker statistical extension may use a different bath-disturbing TEST, but needs an actual positive USE refinement, uniform full-memory operator bound, predictable parameters and fresh private role choices.
quoted_fields.failure: Input-state masking does not close timing/control/routing side channels or certify its own trusted framing. Equivalence concerns the specified Pauli-twirled effective service, not unmodified arbitrary-channel teleportation or every fine-record history. A virtual nonidentity branch is not an observed microscopic fault, conditional output fidelity, QEC independence, future-safe stream or unlimited availability. Biased/coherent USE mismatch generally loses the positive path and needs a finite-block channel allowance instead. Known quantum one-time pads, Pauli twirling, teleportation and sequential estimation are prior methods; no new priority or advantage is acquired. Existing N1004 conditional pulse bounds do not acquire these complete physical interfaces.
